title: Google Search Senior Design System UX Engineer: L6 Technical Deep Dive & Masterclass
description: Comprehensive, 14-minute Staff-level technical masterclass generated using Gemini native multi-speaker audio (gemini-3.8-flash-tts with Aoede and Algenib). Covers complete interview drills for hiring manager Mindy Deli Carpini on the Google Search Design System: the 90-second positioned pitch, clean Google exit framing, Wiz 3-layer component state architecture (jsaction, URL single source of truth, Soy/Web Component slots), zero-JS token delivery, CSS containment (contain: layout size) to prevent CLS under streaming AI Overviews, live coding autocomplete mechanics (AbortController, aria-activedescendant, mousedown event timing, IME composition), and L6 behavioral leadership with cross-functional conflict resolution.
